impact_assessments.concern: a plausible coverage figure is produced from a population the engine did not read

dimensions.consequence: assurance work is redirected and missing tests can be reported as covered
dimensions.detectability: low unless premise metrics and silent-zero sentinels are inspected
dimensions.recovery: rerun the pinned corpus and publish a corrected record with the invalidation reason
dimensions.reversibility: the conclusion can be retracted after rerunning with complete provenance
dimensions.scope_of_effect: every consumer of the affected coverage payload

impact_assessments.rationale: consumers use these measurements to prioritize test and specification work
impact_assessments.scenario: reviewers accept a backed-row percentage while trace bindings or minted rows are absent
impact_assessments.uncertainty: controlled-corpus coverage does not establish behavior for every repository convention

review_selection.rationale: changes can alter both the measured population and the interpretation of its result
